ROTOR LOCK SOLUTIONS



DESCRIPTION
Rotor locks are used in the wind turbine industr y and are
t ypically mounted close to the turbine´s main rotor shaft,
bet ween gearbox and rotor. A rotor brake is primarily
intended for use as safet y brake during emergency
stops under high wind conditions. The rotor lock is
activated by running the lock bolt into the lock disc using
hydraulic power; a “locked” signal is then transmitted to
the control system.
All Svendborg Brakes rotor lock units are engineered to
handle the large output torque generated by the rotor
found in wind turbine.
